content.comment_body: Hello, I'm seeking assistance with an issue. I created a simple user interface using [product_name] Web Editor, and it functioned well. However, I also want to use the [product_name] Access Tool at the same time, but they are not working together. If I select the "Allow HTTP access (Web Server and [product_name] App)" option in the settings, only the [product_name] Access Tool works. If I choose "Allow HTTPS access only," my web interface is accessible, but the [product_name] Access Tool stops functioning. Could someone please advise?
Please consider starting a support request for more help.
In my experience, both the access tool and the web server work simultaneously with the "https" setting, and I haven't encountered any issues.

analysis.insight_summary: A user encounters a conflict where the [product_name] Access Tool and a web interface built with [product_name] Web Editor cannot operate at the same time based on the chosen security setting, with only one working depending on whether HTTP or HTTPS is enabled. Another user shares that they do not have this issue, suggesting inconsistent behavior across different setups and possible gaps in documentation or hidden constraints.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes both the [product_name] Access Tool and the web interface designed with [product_name] Web Editor will operate together, regardless of which security setting (HTTP or HTTPS) is selected.
